page:
Mount for interoperating with web frameworks built on Web Standard. Elysia.mount enables gradual migration or multi-framework use. Example: mount Hono at /hono via .mount('/hono', hono.fetch). Allows frameworks like Hono, H3, etc to run together. Useful for migration or mixed framework applications.
Questions: What is mount? How do you use it? What frameworks support it?
